Definition: Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe
BiblicalUsage: Zebulun = "exalted"; n pr m; 1) the 10th of the sons of Jacob, 6th and last of Leah; progenitor of Zebulun; 2) the tribe descended from Zebulun; n pr loc; 3) the land allocated to the tribe of Zebulun
